reading: George McMaster began his farming career by milking eight cows and checking their health by eye.
Today, he monitors a herd of 300 cows through an AI camera at his farm near Islandmagee.
The camera's software identifies each cow, analyses a short daily video and highlights changes that people may not yet see.
The farmer says the camera helps identify cows with walking problems earlier than daily observation alone.
The farmer believes healthier cows produce more milk, bringing benefits for both animals and farmers.
Cows enter a robotic milking machine whenever they choose, instead of being gathered at fixed times.
Better broadband has allowed the farmer to open a farm shop that accepts electronic payments.
The farmer has used the FarmDrive app to run his business for four years.
The app lets him enter information immediately, instead of writing it down in both the cattle building and the office.
It also allows him to prepare reports for inspections, including details about animal medicines and feed.
Each cow can have a profile that keeps all her information together, with the option of adding a photo.
The developer sees AI as an adviser that helps farmers find useful information and work more efficiently.
He believes farmers should remain responsible for decisions, rather than letting AI make those decisions for them.

vocabulary.definition: Regularly watches or checks something to notice changes.
Draws attention to something so that it is easier to notice.
The activity of watching carefully to learn about something.
Official checks to see whether rules and standards are being followed.
A page or section in an app containing information about one person or animal.
Someone or something that offers information and suggestions to help with decisions.
In a way that uses time and effort well, with little waste.

entries.ja: 変化に気づくために、定期的に何かを見たり確認したりすること。
entries.ko: 변화를 알아차리기 위해 어떤 것을 정기적으로 살피거나 확인하는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 定期观察或检查某个事物，以发现变化。
entries.es: Observa o revisa algo con regularidad para detectar cambios.
entries.pt-BR: Observa ou verifica algo regularmente para perceber mudanças.
entries.fr: Observe ou vérifie régulièrement quelque chose pour repérer des changements.
entries.de: Beobachtet oder überprüft etwas regelmäßig, um Veränderungen zu bemerken.

entries.ja: 何かに気づきやすくなるように、そこに注意を向けさせること。
entries.ko: 어떤 것을 더 쉽게 알아차릴 수 있도록 주의를 끄는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 让人注意到某个事物，使其更容易被察觉。
entries.es: Llama la atención sobre algo para que sea más fácil notarlo.
entries.pt-BR: Chama a atenção para algo para que seja mais fácil percebê-lo.
entries.fr: Attire l’attention sur quelque chose pour qu’il soit plus facile à remarquer.
entries.de: Lenkt die Aufmerksamkeit auf etwas, damit es leichter bemerkt wird.

entries.ja: 何かについて知るために、注意深く見ること。
entries.ko: 어떤 것에 대해 알아보기 위해 주의 깊게 살펴보는 활동.
entries.zh-Hans: 为了了解某个事物而仔细观察的活动。
entries.es: La actividad de mirar con atención para aprender sobre algo.
entries.pt-BR: A atividade de observar com atenção para aprender sobre algo.
entries.fr: Le fait de regarder attentivement pour apprendre quelque chose sur ce que l’on observe.
entries.de: Das aufmerksame Beobachten, um etwas über eine Sache zu erfahren.

entries.ja: 規則や基準が守られているかを確かめるための公式な検査。
entries.ko: 규칙과 기준이 지켜지고 있는지 확인하는 공식적인 검사.
entries.zh-Hans: 为确认是否正在遵守规则和标准而进行的正式检查。
entries.es: Revisiones oficiales para comprobar si se están cumpliendo las reglas y las normas.
entries.pt-BR: Verificações oficiais para conferir se as regras e os padrões estão sendo seguidos.
entries.fr: Des contrôles officiels visant à vérifier si les règles et les normes sont respectées.
entries.de: Offizielle Kontrollen, bei denen geprüft wird, ob Regeln und Standards eingehalten werden.

entries.ja: 一人の人や一頭の動物についての情報をまとめた、アプリ内のページや項目。
entries.ko: 한 사람이나 한 마리의 동물에 관한 정보가 담긴 앱의 페이지나 구역.
entries.zh-Hans: 应用程序中包含一个人或一只动物相关信息的页面或栏目。
entries.es: Una página o sección de una aplicación que contiene información sobre una persona o un animal.
entries.pt-BR: Uma página ou seção de um aplicativo que contém informações sobre uma pessoa ou um animal.
entries.fr: Une page ou une rubrique d’une application contenant des informations sur une personne ou un animal.
entries.de: Eine Seite oder ein Bereich in einer App mit Informationen über eine einzelne Person oder ein einzelnes Tier.

entries.ja: 判断の助けとなる情報や提案を提供する人やもの。
entries.ko: 결정을 돕기 위해 정보와 제안을 제공하는 사람 또는 무언가.
entries.zh-Hans: 提供信息和建议以帮助作出决定的人或事物。
entries.es: Alguien o algo que ofrece información y sugerencias para ayudar a tomar decisiones.
entries.pt-BR: Alguém ou algo que oferece informações e sugestões para ajudar a tomar decisões.
entries.fr: Une personne ou une chose qui fournit des informations et des suggestions pour aider à prendre des décisions.
entries.de: Jemand oder etwas, der beziehungsweise das Informationen und Vorschläge anbietet, um bei Entscheidungen zu helfen.

entries.ja: 時間や労力をうまく使い、無駄を少なくして。
entries.ko: 시간과 노력을 잘 활용하고 낭비를 적게 하여.
entries.zh-Hans: 以充分利用时间和精力、很少浪费的方式。
entries.es: De una manera que aprovecha bien el tiempo y el esfuerzo, con poco desperdicio.
entries.pt-BR: De uma maneira que aproveita bem o tempo e o esforço, com pouco desperdício.
entries.fr: D’une manière qui utilise bien le temps et les efforts, avec peu de gaspillage.
entries.de: Auf eine Weise, die Zeit und Mühe gut nutzt und dabei wenig verschwendet.
